install.grok: Grok → Skills → replace the content of "au-compliance-kb" with this file.
install.claude: Claude → Settings → Capabilities → Skills → upload the au-compliance-kb folder (zip). Needs the Dropbox connector.
install.codex: Put AGENTS.md in the folder Codex is opened in (the synced knowledge-base root).
install.gemini: Put GEMINI.md in the folder Gemini CLI is started in (the synced knowledge-base root).
